text:
Jordan (Finance Ops): Heads-up — VantEdge Health is asking for a custom 12mo commit with a monthly overage cap + one-time onboarding credit. Can we get a quick sign-off?
Priya (AE): They just closed PO, want committed pricing to hit procurement deadlines. Contract signed pending pricing appendix.
Jordan (Finance Ops): Key numbers from AE: commit = $60,000/yr, tiered unit pricing below. Overage cap requested $8,000/mo, one-time setup credit $5,000.
Priya (AE): They want net30 and a clause that caps per-month overage billing. Procurement is pushing for the cap or they'll go to competitors.
Malik (RevOps): Quick checks: at $60k/yr we need to confirm margin vs cost. Also need to ensure usage forecasting + gating on burst.
Jordan (Finance Ops): Proposed tiered rates (draft):
```
Commit: $60,000/yr (12mo)
Tiered price: 0-500k tokens @ $0.00050/token
>500k tokens @ $0.00045/token
Overage cap: $8,000/month
One-time onboarding credit: $5,000 (applied to first invoice)
Payment terms: Net30
Term: 12 months, auto-renew opt-out 30d
```
Saanvi (Legal): Need to avoid hard caps that create exposure. Suggest: cap applies only if customer has >90% of committed usage for prior 2 months; else cap void. Also warranty & indemnity language stays standard.
Alex (SalesOps): If we add the 90% usage gate, AE will lose procurement leverage. Is there a middle ground like a phased cap (first 3 months fixed cap, then usage-based)?
Priya (AE): Procurement insists on certainty; phased cap could work — they care most about first 6 months.
Malik (RevOps): From a forecasting POV, propose: cap applies months 1–6 at $8k, months 7–12 cap reduces to $4k unless usage hit >80% of commit for months 3–6, then full cap stays. This protects us if they severely underuse.
Jordan (Finance Ops): Good. Need to confirm impact to ARR recognition and bill-run. Also need special pricing approval from Dana due to >20% discount vs list.
Dana (CFO): Send me the final economics. My baseline: max effective discount should not reduce gross margin below 60%. I can approve with staged cap + usage gate.
Priya (AE): Attaching customer ask summary (copied below). Procurement deadline EOD Friday.
deal-bot: Deal updated: VantEdge Health — Opportunity 2026-045 — Entered special pricing request. (link: https://sales.internal/opps/2026-045) :white_check_mark:
Jordan (Finance Ops): Quick math: at forecasted usage (650k tokens/mo) we estimate monthly overage without cap ~$10k; with cap $8k for first 6 months then variable. Discount from list is ~25% on effective unit price.
Saanvi (Legal): I'll draft an appendix: staged cap terms + usage-gate clause + clause limiting cap to non-fraudulent usage. Also add audit rights.
Malik (RevOps): For billing system: implement cap as an invoice-level credit up to $8k during months 1–6 and up to $4k months 7–12 conditioned on usage thresholds. I can scope the BillRun change request.
Jordan (Finance Ops): Dana, final ask: approve special pricing (effective discount ~25%), staged overage cap (8k m1-6, 4k m7-12 conditional), $5k onboarding credit, net30. I can attach projected P&L.
Dana (CFO): Approve with these conditions: 1) Saanvi's usage gate language included, 2) RevOps implements automated alert if monthly cost delta >15% vs forecast, 3) Finance retains right to clawback credits if audit finds misuse. Approving now.
Priya (AE): Amazing — thanks Dana! I'll get legal appendix signed and procurement notified.
Jordan (Finance Ops): Will update deal record and create the special pricing memo. Malik — please open BillRun task and tag for priority.
Malik (RevOps): On it — ticket created (#BR-9812). ETA: 2 business days to deploy invoice credit logic.
Saanvi (Legal): Draft ready, will route via DocuSign after AE confirms.
Jordan (Finance Ops): Final note: Alex, please update the pricing registry and mark this as non-standard (approved exception).
Alex (SalesOps): Done — registry updated and noted approval conditions.
Priya (AE): Procurement notified, they want welcome call Friday.
Jordan (Finance Ops): Closing thread — special pricing approved with conditions. I will post the final memo in the deal record and attach the appendix once signed. :tada:
